name: Workato
description: Connect your own Workato workspace to see and manage your recipes from Imperal -- list/create/update/copy/delete recipes, start/stop them, force a run, inspect their jobs, manage connections, folders/projects, tags, lookup tables (full row-level CRUD), environment properties, and recipe lifecycle packages. Your Workato API Client token is verified against your own workspace before it's saved.

tools.name: connect_workato
tools.description: Connect your Workato workspace by saving your own API Client Bearer token, after discovering which data center your workspace lives on and checking the token actually works there. Create the token in your workspace: Workspace admin -> API clients -> Create API client, assign it a role and project scope, then copy its token. No need to know your own data center -- it's discovered automatically.

api_token.description: Workato API Client Bearer token -- create it in your workspace: Workspace admin -> API clients -> Create API client, assign it a role and project scope, then copy its token.
api_token.title: Api Token

tools.name: get_workato_connection
tools.description: Check whether Workato is currently connected (does not reveal the saved token).

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: disconnect_workato
tools.description: Disconnect Workato: deletes the saved API Client token and data center. Existing recipes, connections and jobs in your own Workato workspace are not affected -- only Imperal's saved credential is removed.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: list_workato_recipes
tools.description: List recipes (Workato's term for workflows) in the connected workspace -- name, running state, folder/project, trigger app, and lifetime job counts.

folder_id.description: Filter to one folder. Empty for all reachable folders.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

project_id.description: Filter to one project. Empty for all.
project_id.title: Project Id

running.description: Filter by running/stopped state. Omit for all.
running.title: Running

tools.name: get_workato_recipe
tools.description: Read one Workato recipe in full -- its running state, trigger/action apps, folder/project, and lifetime job counts.

include_tags.description: Include the recipe's tags in the response.
include_tags.title: Include Tags

tools.name: create_workato_recipe
tools.description: Create a brand-new, empty Workato recipe in a folder. You'll still need to build its trigger/action steps in the Workato recipe editor -- this creates the container, not a working automation.

folder_id.description: Folder to create the recipe in. Empty for root.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tools.name: update_workato_recipe
tools.description: Rename an existing Workato recipe.

name.description: New recipe name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
name.title: Name

tools.name: copy_workato_recipe
tools.description: Copy an existing Workato recipe -- same steps/logic, a new id and name, optionally into a different folder.

folder_id.description: Folder to place the copy in. Empty keeps the source's folder.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tools.name: delete_workato_recipe
tools.description: Permanently delete a Workato recipe. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: start_workato_recipe
tools.description: Start (turn on) a Workato recipe so its trigger begins running.

tools.name: stop_workato_recipe
tools.description: Stop (turn off) a running Workato recipe.

tools.name: reset_workato_recipe_trigger
tools.description: Reset a recipe's trigger -- clears its stored polling/watermark state so the next run re-evaluates from scratch. Use after fixing a stuck trigger.

tools.name: force_run_workato_recipe
tools.description: Force a Workato recipe to run right now, on demand, regardless of its trigger schedule. Executes real actions in your connected apps.

tools.name: poll_now_workato_recipe
tools.description: Activate a recipe's polling trigger immediately, instead of waiting for its next scheduled poll interval.

tools.name: reconnect_workato_recipe_application
tools.description: Update which connection a stopped recipe uses for one of its applications -- e.g. swap a Salesforce sandbox connection for production. The recipe must be stopped first.

connection_id.description: New connection id to use for this recipe's application.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_workato_recipe_versions
tools.description: List the saved version history of one Workato recipe.

tools.name: get_workato_recipe_version
tools.description: Read one specific saved version of a Workato recipe in full.

tools.name: get_workato_recipe_health
tools.description: Retrieve the most recent optimization/health analysis for a Workato recipe.

tools.name: list_workato_connections
tools.description: List the app connections in your Workato workspace -- what a recipe's trigger/action steps actually authenticate through.

folder_id.description: Filter to one folder. Empty for all.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

project_id.description: Filter to one project. Empty for all.
project_id.title: Project Id

include_tags.description: Include each connection's tags in the response.
include_tags.title: Include Tags

tools.name: create_workato_connection
tools.description: Create a new connection in your Workato workspace -- the credential a recipe's steps authenticate through. Input fields are provider-specific (e.g. a Salesforce connection needs different fields than a Slack one).

folder_id.description: Folder to create the connection in. Empty for root.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

input_json.description: JSON object of provider-specific connection input fields.
input_json.title: Input Json

tools.name: update_workato_connection
tools.description: Update an existing Workato connection's name and/or provider-specific input fields.

name.description: New connection name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
name.title: Name

input_json.description: JSON object of provider-specific fields to change. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
input_json.title: Input Json

tools.name: disconnect_workato_connection
tools.description: Disconnect a Workato connection (breaks its live authorization without deleting it). Recipes using it will fail until it's reconnected or replaced.

tools.name: delete_workato_connection
tools.description: Permanently delete a Workato connection. Recipes using it will stop working once it's gone. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_workato_connection_picklist
tools.description: Get picklist values for a Workato connection -- the dropdown options a recipe step's field would show (e.g. valid Salesforce object names).

picklist_name.title: Picklist Name

extra_json.description: JSON object of extra picklist-dependent parameters, if the picklist needs them.
extra_json.title: Extra Json

tools.name: list_workato_recipe_jobs
tools.description: List past/current jobs (runs) for a Workato recipe -- status, timing, and whether each was a poll error.

recipe_id.description: Workato recipe id whose jobs to list.
recipe_id.title: Recipe Id

since.description: ISO8601 -- only jobs completed after this time.
since.title: Since

until.description: ISO8601 -- only jobs completed before this time.
until.title: Until

status.title: Status

include_var.description: Include run-time input/output variable data (larger response).
include_var.title: Include Var

parent_id.title: Parent Id

tools.name: create_workato_folder

name.title: Name

tools.name: update_workato_folder

tools.name: delete_workato_folder
tools.description: Permanently delete a Workato folder. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_workato_projects

project_id.title: Project Id

tools.description: Permanently delete a Workato project. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_workato_tags
